collection.title: Ford Tourneo Connect (with Tailgate) 2013 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Tourneo Connect 2013 Onwards requires a 30" wiper blade for both drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Tourneo Connect which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.

image.alt: Ford Tourneo Connect (with Tailgate) 2013 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
